{{Otheruses|High Priest}}
The '''High Priest of the [[Golden Sun]]''' was the title used by the [[Sedrian]] leader. Their commands and dictates came directly from the Golden Sun itself; although the people who worshiped it did not realize that it was a sentient being itself.

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]] held the position of High Priest of the Golden Sun.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
